guidance: Ironclad A0 Act2 floor18 MAP, 80/80 HP, 204 gold, Weak Potion and Duplicator held, Very Hot Cocoa grants four extra energy on the first combat turn. Choose the middle Monster row1/col2 (map option1), whose row2 options include Unknown and whose later route can reach a Rest Site at row6/col4 without a forced Elite; left and right branches have worse visible risk or forced Elite. In combat, exploit first-turn energy for high-value setup/damage but do not spend it on pointless block against a harmless intent. Use upgraded Armaments early when it upgrades multiple useful cards, Aggression for recurring upgraded attacks, Bash before Dismantle, and Headbutt to recur Rampage or other strong attacks. Cloak Clasp and Gorget reward preserving enough hand/block; compare against actual intents. Preserve potions unless they prevent meaningful damage or secure lethal. Claim all rewards and evaluate card choice for boss scaling/survival. Stop at floor19 MAP, terminal or safety boundary.
